story:
SETS (make each one a cast member of kind "set" and give every shot the set of the place it shows):
1. The courtyard of a Hanoi tube house: a tiled yard with low stools, a charcoal stove and a big pot (kit place: garden); afternoon, night, dawn
2. The family's front room with the ancestor altar (kit place: living-room); dawn
3. Hanoi's old quarter rooftops under New Year's Eve fireworks (kit place: village); midnight

KEY OBJECT (the owner's notes — draw it exactly so): Bánh chưng: a flat SQUARE parcel wrapped in glossy green dong leaves with visible leaf texture (veins), tied with two pairs of thin pale bamboo strings each way (four strings crossing in a grid, NOT a ribbon, NO bow), a darker green leaf fold at the corners. ONE look only (owner 2026-10-12, D77): the wrapped parcel; the cooking is told by the pot and the fire in the courtyard sets. The front room has no altar drawn (owner + QC 2026-10-12, D78): in the LAST shot the bánh chưng sits on a small wooden table in the front room, in the centre, big enough to read — draw that table in the shot, do not change the set.

Chiều Ba Mươi Tết, bé An cùng bà gói bánh chưng trong sân nhà ở phố cổ Hà Nội. Bà trải lá dong xanh lên mâm, đong gạo nếp trắng, nhân đậu xanh và thịt. An học bà gấp lá thật vuông và buộc lạt tre thật chặt. Chiếc bánh đầu tiên An tự gói, bà khen vuông vắn như bánh của người lớn. Đêm xuống, nồi bánh sôi lục bục trên bếp lửa hồng giữa sân. Hai bà cháu ngồi canh nồi bánh, bà kể chuyện Lang Liêu dâng bánh cho vua Hùng. Bà chỉ chiếc bánh vuông như mặt đất, An tròn mắt lắng nghe. Đêm giao thừa, pháo hoa nở rực trên những mái ngói phố cổ. An ngủ gục trên vai bà, tay vẫn nắm sợi lạt tre. Sáng mùng Một, An mở mắt và chạy ra phòng khách. Trên bàn là chiếc bánh chưng vuông vức đầu tiên do chính tay An gói.

modelNotes: vision: no NVIDIA vision model in the catalog, so openbmb/MiniCPM-V-4_5 LOOKS at each render and Nemotron Nano still scores it (vision critic: openbmb/MiniCPM-V-4_5; Nemotron crew: Ultra/Super/Nano).

bible.title: Bánh Chưng Tết: Ký Ức Của An
bible.logline: Chiều Ba Mươi Tết, bé An học gói bánh chưng cùng bà, qua đêm canh nồi nghe chuyện xưa, sáng mùng Một thức dậy thấy chiếc bánh đầu đời vuông vức trên bàn thờ.

cast.name: Sân nhà phố cổ
cast.look: Narrow tube house courtyard with tiled floor, low wooden stools, a charcoal stove with a big iron pot, brick walls, open sky

cast.name: Phòng khách bàn thờ
cast.look: Family front room with ancestor altar centered on main wall, brass incense burner, candle holders, fresh flowers, framed photograph, wooden floor

cast.name: Mái ngói phố cổ
cast.look: Hanoi old quarter rooftops with terracotta tiles, narrow alleys, night sky illuminated by fireworks

cast.name: Bé An
cast.look: Small child, round face, short black hair, wearing a simple áo bà ba in soft beige, bare feet

cast.name: Bà
cast.look: Elderly woman, gentle smile, silver hair in a bun, wearing a dark áo dài with subtle floral pattern, hands wrinkled

cast.name: Bánh chưng
cast.look: Flat square parcel wrapped in glossy green dong leaves with visible veins, tied with four thin pale bamboo strings in a grid, darker green leaf folds at corners

parts.look: flat square block about as thick as a thumb, wrapped tight in whole leaves, edges sharp and corners folded to points
glossy bright green leaf sheets covering all faces, clear vein lines running lengthwise, darker green triangular folds tucked at each corner
four thin pale bamboo strips, two running left–right and two front–back, crossing in a neat grid on top and bottom, no bow or knot visible
darker green leaf tips folded into sharp triangles at the four corners, tucked under the grid strings

shots.description: Wide shot of the Hanoi tube house courtyard in golden afternoon light. Bé An and Bà stand near the charcoal stove, low stools and big iron pot visible, brick walls and tiled floor. An holds a dong leaf, Bà smiles.
shots.dialogue: Chiều Ba Mươi Tết, bé An cùng bà gói bánh chưng trong sân nhà ở phố cổ Hà Nội.

shots.description: Medium shot, close on Bà's hands spreading glossy green dong leaves on a woven mat, white glutinous rice, mung bean filling and pork laid out. Afternoon light filters through courtyard bricks.
shots.dialogue: Bà trải lá dong xanh lên mâm, đong gạo nếp trắng, nhân đậu xanh và thịt.

shots.description: Over-the-shoulder two-shot from behind An as Bà guides her small hands folding the dong leaves into a perfect square and tying four pale bamboo strings in a tight grid. The courtyard afternoon light softens.
shots.dialogue: An học bà gấp lá thật vuông và buộc lạt tre thật chặt.

shots.description: Close-up on the finished square bánh chưng resting in An's cupped palms, leaf veins and bamboo grid sharp. Bà leans in, smiling proudly, afternoon glow on their faces.
shots.dialogue: Chiếc bánh đầu tiên An tự gói, bà khen vuông vắn như bánh của người lớn.

shots.description: Wide shot of the courtyard at night, charcoal stove glowing red, big iron pot bubbling with steam. An and Bà sit on low stools beside the fire, the wrapped bánh chưng parcels visible on a stool nearby. Night shadows, lantern glow.
shots.dialogue: Đêm xuống, nồi bánh sôi lục bục trên bếp lửa hồng giữa sân.

shots.description: Medium two-shot, An and Bà side by side on stools watching the pot, Bà gestures toward the square parcel as she tells the legend of Lang Liêu. Night deepens, firelight dances on their faces.
shots.dialogue: Hai bà cháu ngồi canh nồi bánh, bà kể chuyện Lang Liêu dâng bánh cho vua Hùng.

shots.description: Close-up on Bà's finger pointing at the square bánh chưng on the stool, An's round eyes wide with wonder, firelight reflecting. Night, intimate.
shots.dialogue: Bà chỉ chiếc bánh vuông như mặt đất, An tròn mắt lắng nghe.

shots.description: Wide shot of Hanoi old quarter rooftops under midnight sky, fireworks blooming in vivid reds and golds over terracotta tiles. An and Bà silhouetted on a rooftop, watching.
shots.dialogue: Đêm giao thừa, pháo hoa nở rực trên những mái ngói phố cổ.

shots.description: Close-up on An asleep on Bà's lap, her small fingers still curled around a pale bamboo string from the bánh chưng. Fireworks glow softly on their faces, midnight.
shots.dialogue: An ngủ gục trên vai bà, tay vẫn nắm sợi lạt tre.

shots.description: Medium shot from low angle in the front room at dawn, An darts across wooden floor toward the small wooden table centered under the ancestor altar wall. Dawn light paints the room gold.
shots.dialogue: Sáng mùng Một, An mở mắt và chạy ra phòng khách.

shots.description: Close-up detail shot of the square bánh chưng sitting on the small wooden table in the front room, leaf veins and bamboo grid perfectly clear in morning light. The ancestor altar wall behind, no altar drawn, just the table and parcel. Dawn.
shots.dialogue: Trên bàn là chiếc bánh chưng vuông vức đầu tiên do chính tay An gói.

actionNotes.6: The key object (square parcel) is not clearly shown.
actionNotes.9: Bánh chưng appears too large and mispositioned, not clearly visible as a small held prop

continuity: Shot 11 mentions 'ancestor altar wall' but the set description says the altar is centered on the main wall; the altar itself is not drawn, only the wall is visible, which may cause a continuity inconsistency

Shot 11 shows the bánh chưng on a small wooden table in the front room, but earlier shots place the altar centered on the main wall; moving the parcel to a table away from the altar may break spatial continuity

Shot 11 uses 'low angle' but the description says 'medium shot from low angle in the front room', which conflicts with the earlier 'low angle' label used only for Shot 10; this could cause confusion in shot labeling

Shot 11's time reference 'Sáng mùng Một' (first day of the new year) implies dawn after midnight fireworks, but the transition from night fireworks to dawn in the same shot may require a clearer time jump

Shot 11's close-up focuses on the bánh chưng on the table while the ancestor altar wall is mentioned but not shown; this could cause a continuity issue if the altar is expected to be visible in the frame

Shot 11's description says 'no altar drawn, just the table and parcel', yet the set includes an ancestor altar; omitting the altar may be a continuity error if the altar is supposed to be present in the scene
